The sheet has two PCSA display classes (6-significant-digit computed values and 3-digit rounded); AB 8.91E-5 is 3-digit-rounded yet disagrees with its own row by 68% - the value was rounded from a computation inconsistent with BOTH current cells (edited later or from a different measurement round). AB rows are corrupted across species (Hylobates leg1 closure +76.9%, leg2 additivity +18.4% + a 12 mm FL outlier). Undecidable origin; quarantine right.
